# Boundary Decision Memory Template

## Problem boundary

[What is inside and outside the frame?]

## System boundary

[What wider system shapes the problem?]

## Stakeholder boundary

[Who counts, who is missing, and why?]

## Causal boundary

[Which causes are included and excluded?]

## Temporal boundary

[What time horizon matters?]

## Institutional boundary

[What can we decide, influence, coordinate, escalate, or monitor?]

## Evidence boundary

[What knowledge counts?]

## Ethical boundary

[Who benefits, who may be harmed, and what redress exists?]

## Excluded scope

[What is outside this strategy but should be monitored?]

## Revision triggers

[Evidence that changes the boundary]

## Archived learning

[What future teams should know]
